glosses: torus (thickening of a membrane closing a wood-cell pit)

examples.text: Non morirà. È forte come un toro.
examples.en: He won't die. He is as strong as a horse.

examples.text: Uno dei tori abbatté lo steccato.
examples.en: One of the bulls pushed the fence down.

examples.text: Devi prendere il toro per le corna!
examples.en: You've got to take the bull by the horns!
We should settle things once and for all.
